items.title: Pornhub Stars Want to Teach You How to Make Dinner
items.content_text: Faced with censorship and anti-porn laws, the adult site is encouraging creators to embrace cooking, gaming, podcasting, and other safe-for-work content.
items.summary: Faced with censorship and anti-porn laws, the adult site is encouraging creators to embrace cooking, gaming, podcasting, and other safe-for-work content.

items.title: Macmillan Staff Say the Publisher Threw a Party for a Workplace AI Assistant That Was Later Killed
items.content_text: Workers tell WIRED that NOA—or “No Ordinary Assistant”—was unhelpful. Bestselling authors also say AI is ruining their relationships with Big Five publishers.
